description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for an Android TV application. It extends FragmentActivity to set up a compose-based UI that displays a home screen with navigation items, a hero section, and multiple rails of cards, including a sample section for TV channels. It handles remote control key events such as navigation and selection.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity for the Android TV app, initializing the home screen UI with compose and handling remote key events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the compose view, and populates the home screen with sample data.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events from the TV remote, such as navigation and selection buttons.
